item.description: In robotics, shape control, or shape servoing, refers to the automatic manipulation of a deformable object toward a desired shape. item.title: El Agente F'armaco: A Scalable AI Scientist for Drug Discovery
item.description: Computational drug discovery offers a growing range of tools for proposing and evaluating molecules, but combining them and deciding what to do next still requires substantial expert effort. item.title: ActOR: Ambient AI-Based Agentic Orchestration for Humanoid Autonomy in Operating Rooms
item.description: Operating rooms (ORs) increasingly contain ambient sensing infrastructure to enable AI-based optimization of workflows and utilization. We pursue an alternative path: using ambient AI to guide robot action and optimize utilization.

item.title: Learnings and Pitfalls from AI-Assisted A/B Experimentation at Scale
item.description: A/B testing underpins product decisions by providing trustworthy, reproducible quantification of proposed changes' effects. Growing large language model (LLM) capabilities have motivated efforts to automate experimentation workflows.

item.title: Reasoning about Shared-Qubit Concurrency in Quantum Computing
item.description: In this paper, we develop a semantic model for the parallel execution of quantum circuits, providing a formal foundation for studying shared-qubit concurrency in quantum computing. As in classical shared-memory concurrency, parallel quantum circuits may interfere with one another through operations on shared qubits.

item.title: Reopening the one clean qubit case of a semi-grand challenge
item.description: In his 2005 list of semi-grand challenges for quantum computing theory, Scott Aaronson asked whether a quantum computer that is always in a separable mixed state can be simulated by a classical computer in polynomial time. An affirmative answer was claimed for the one clean qubit model of quantum computation.

item.title: EvoMemState: Evolving Memory State for Personal Agents
item.description: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to provide continuous personalized assistance by retaining user information across interactions. Existing systems support this process through fact extraction, organization, updating, and retrieval, but largely maintain memories as independent facts.

item.title: Sleep-Disordered Breathing Detection with Quantum Recurrent Neural Networks

item.title: ReContact: Reconstruct and Retarget Human Contacts from Video for Contact-Rich Humanoid Manipulation
item.description: Contact transitions allow humanoid robots to redistribute object support across the whole body, enabling manipulation beyond hand-only grasps. Human videos provide a scalable source of such transitions for robots to learn from.

item.title: Towards Optimal Routing Strategies for qLDPC codes on Silicon Spin Qubits
item.description: One of the major challenges of implementing high-rate quantum error correction codes, like qLDPC codes, is realizing the required long-range interactions. Spin qubit platforms can provide this connectivity by shuttling qubits next to each other whenever they need to interact.

item.title: BLPO: Beyond-Local Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
item.description: Long-horizon tasks require large language model (LLM) agents to coordinate interdependent actions, a capability central to automating complex workflows. item.description: Recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly large-scale deep learning, have been driven by monolithic or offline training on massive curated datasets. While successful, these approaches face structural limitations: escalating data and computational demands, limited online adaptability, and a lack of s

item.title: Pixel: A Co-Designed Full-Stack Robot System for Learning General-Purpose Mobile Manipulation
item.description: General-purpose mobile manipulation requires a combination of capable robot hardware, scalable demonstration collection, expressive whole-body control, and effective policy learning. Yet these components are often developed independently, creating mismatches that limit the capabilities of the complete system.

item.title: Reimagining Text-to-SQL: A Survey of Large Language Model Architectures and Strategies
item.description: Text-to-SQL systems translate natural language questions into executable SQL queries, democratizing access to relational data. item.title: Anchor 1: Precise and Stable Humanoid Control for Whole-Body Manipulation
item.description: Humanoid controllers have acquired increasingly diverse motor skills, yet translating these capabilities into precise and stable whole-body manipulation remains challenging. Manipulation tasks are sensitive to execution deviations -- even small errors or unintended steps can cause failure.

item.title: WorldSketch: Sketching World Models for Zero-Shot Mobile Manipulation
item.description: Most agentic robotic systems use vision-language models (VLMs) either to orchestrate predefined skills or to directly generate actions, constraints, and control programs. The former is limited by the available skill library, while the latter requires VLMs to reason about precise geometry and contact.

item.title: MOST: Memory of Object States and Task Progress for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
item.description: Long-horizon embodied manipulation requires policies to act on information that is no longer visible. Modified objects may leave the field of view, while completed subtasks continue to constrain future actions.

item.title: ODE Policy: Robot Learning via Action Dynamics, Not Actions
item.description: Most robot policies, whether trained by imitation learning (IL) or reinforcement learning (RL), map observations to action values at discrete control steps and leave the continuity of physical motion to be learned implicitly. We propose ODE policy, which learns the dynamics of the action rather than the action itself.

item.title: Neuro Inspired Robotics: What Robot Learning Can Borrow from the Sensorimotor Brain
item.description: Robot policies still fail at everyday manipulation: an unfamiliar task, an object never held before, a scene that changes mid-motion, a skill that should improve with use.
